  Issue-area breakdown: keyword tagging of bill titles/subjects — not official legislative categories.

  Vote data coverage: see 'Data coverage' line above for completeness status.

[METHODOLOGY — how these metrics are derived]
  Caucus read is plain-language shorthand derived from OpenStates roll-call data (confirmed votes only). Split-vote threshold: 15–85% of party voting YES, minimum 5 members voting.
  Party alignment %: share of floor votes matching party majority option. Source: OpenStates voter records.
  Breaks from party: actual recorded NO votes against the party YES majority.
  Issue-area breakdown: keyword tagging of bill titles/subjects — not official legislative categories.
  Co-sponsorship: bills listing multiple sponsors on OpenStates. Primary patron vs. co-patron role not distinguished.
  Vote data coverage: see 'Data coverage' line above for completeness status.

  Caucus read is plain-language shorthand derived from OpenStates roll-call data (confirmed votes only). Split-vote threshold: 15–85% of party voting YES, minimum 5 members voting.

  Breaks from party: actual recorded NO votes against the party YES majority.
  Issue-area breakdown: keyword tagging of bill titles/subjects — not official legislative categories.
  Co-sponsorship: bills listing multiple sponsors on OpenStates. Primary patron vs. co-patron role not distinguished.
  Vote data coverage: see 'Data coverage' line above for completeness status.

[METHODOLOGY — how these metrics are derived]
  Caucus read is plain-language shorthand derived from OpenStates roll-call data (confirmed votes only). Split-vote threshold: 15–85% of party voting YES, minimum 5 members voting.
  Party alignment %: share of floor votes matching party majority option. Source: OpenStates voter records.
  Breaks from party: actual recorded NO votes against the party YES majority.
  Issue-area breakdown: keyword tagging of bill titles/subjects — not official legislative categories.
  Co-sponsorship: bills listing multiple sponsors on OpenStates. Primary patron vs. co-patron role not distinguished.
  Vote data coverage: see 'Data coverage' line above for completeness status.

  Caucus read is plain-language shorthand derived from OpenStates roll-call data (confirmed votes only). Split-vote threshold: 15–85% of party voting YES, minimum 5 members voting.

  Breaks from party: actual recorded NO votes against the party YES majority.
  Issue-area breakdown: keyword tagging of bill titles/subjects — not official legislative categories.
  Co-sponsorship: bills listing multiple sponsors on OpenStates. Primary patron vs. co-patron role not distinguished.
  Vote data coverage: see 'Data coverage' line above for completeness status.

  Caucus read is plain-language shorthand derived from OpenStates roll-call data (confirmed votes only). Split-vote threshold: 15–85% of party voting YES, minimum 5 members voting.
  Party alignment %: share of floor votes matching party majority option. Source: OpenStates voter records.
  Breaks from party: actual recorded NO votes against the party YES majority.
  Issue-area breakdown: keyword tagging of bill titles/subjects — not official legislative categories.
  Co-sponsorship: bills listing multiple sponsors on OpenStates. Primary patron vs. co-patron role not distinguished.
  Vote data coverage: see 'Data coverage' line above for completeness status.
